_comment: A niche is either a flat list of topics, or an object of pillar -> topics. A pillar object rotates: consecutive days come from different pillars, so a broad channel does not run five sleep videos in a row and read as a sleep channel. Filled by hand on purpose (see content.py) — a model asked daily for a topic converges within about two weeks. The pillar name also picks the background footage (stock_bg.THEMES) and the generated fallback prompt (replicate_bg.PILLAR_PROMPT), so a money topic does not open on a night sky.
